title: 不同情绪状态的思想泡泡
prompt: A [SUBJECT] sits alone in a minimalistic room filled with floating, semi-transparent thought bubbles. Each bubble contains a fragment of their face from different emotional states — smiling, crying, screaming — forming a psychological self-portrait suspended in mid-air.
description: 通过 Nano Banana Pro 模型，在极简室内肖像中捕捉心理深度，以漂浮思想泡泡可视化不同情绪状态，适合心理健康宣传或艺术项目，突出内省与情感光谱。
